description: Intent categories for Apple customer support messages on Twitter

intents.name: ios_update_issues
intents.description: Problems with iOS updates including installation errors, failed downloads, version compatibility questions, and post-update bugs.
examples: Yes 'there was an error downloading the software'
They are not on the same iOS one is 11.0.2 and the other is 11.1.2
the worse ios deployment to date period!
After it says verifying it restarts automatically
Was apps, after I did the iOS DL. I rebooted, twice, they finally updated.
iOS 11 and a 6Splus
How about you just put a new update to fix it
iPhone 6s iOS 11.1.2 which is showing as up to date
intents.boundary_notes: Merge with feature_question for version inquiries. If customer asks 'should I upgrade?', classify as ios_update_issues. Even short messages mentioning iOS versions should be classified here.

intents.name: battery_drain_after_update
intents.description: Battery draining faster than expected, rapid power loss, charging issues, or battery percentage jumping unexpectedly.
examples: 11.1.2, I've turned off the background usage and automatic updates. Still draining the battery
Just took phone off the charger 10 minutes ago. Battery down 6 percent already and phone is hot.
Right after taking it off the charger/subsequently after when in use or when locked. It seems every time I unlock it's down significantly
battery drain
My battery was at 80%, and this must have been the 2nd time it's happened
My iPod won't hold a charge. I think the battery might be fried?
Over an hour wasted and a diagnostic check. Only to tell me I need a new battery
intents.boundary_notes: If message mentions BOTH battery drain AND crashing/freezing, classify as device_crash_freeze (crash is the more severe symptom). Even short messages mentioning battery issues should be classified here.

intents.name: device_crash_freeze
intents.description: Phone crashing, freezing, shutting down unexpectedly, becoming unresponsive, or requiring forced restarts.
examples: It happens randomly. Not in any app specifically. I think I've had to hard boot my iPhone at least 10x today because it kept freezing up
Nope. Didn't work. Computer completely froze while trying to log into Google Drive
11.0.3 - it has slowed down and the screen doesn't rotate sometimes.. sometimes it hangs
phone keeps freezing
keeps restarting
My phone will just power off no matter the percentage of the battery
intents.boundary_notes: Include 'sluggish' and 'slow' here even though they could be battery-related. The user experience is 'device not working properly'. Even short messages mentioning crashes/freezes should be classified here.

intents.name: app_malfunction
intents.description: Specific Apple apps (Messages, Safari, Music, iTunes, etc.) not working correctly, Bluetooth/connectivity issues, or feature-specific bugs.
examples: when I tap it nothing happens. restarting does nothing. i went to itunes and it said I hadn't bought the song when I did
I have deleted and re-installed the app twice with no luck. I found the Amazon app is not working either.
All sounds yes when I go to the settings to test it it works but any other that setting no.
Nope. Cant hear. Cant call. Using messenger Calls atm.
I'm using a 6s Plus. Attached img of error. phone cncts via BT for calls, USB for audio.
safari not working
bluetooth issues
Instagram and twitter frequently crash
intents.boundary_notes: Catch-all for feature-specific bugs. If it's about a specific app or feature not working, but the device itself is fine, it's app_malfunction. Even short messages mentioning specific apps should be classified here.

intents.name: account_access
intents.description: Apple ID issues, iCloud problems, login difficulties, password resets, backup/restore issues, or account recovery.
examples: 2/2 and it has my email address there and I am asked for my password which I put in and that is when I get the error message.
Done twice, but issue remains. I've signed out of iCloud in settings as well, signin there works, but not in the app Store App.
No haven't backed up since May and its the July onwards photos I want😭
can't login
icloud password
forgot my apple id
intents.boundary_notes: Include backup/restore issues here even though they could involve apps. The root cause is account/iCloud, not the app itself. Even short messages mentioning login/account issues should be classified here.

resolution_heuristics.description: Defines what constitutes a 'resolved' thread for retrieval purposes
criteria: Thread ends with customer message containing gratitude keywords (thank, thanks, appreciate) AND customer did not report ongoing issue
Thread ends with customer confirming issue is fixed (working, worked, resolved, got them back)
Brand responded with ACTUAL TROUBLESHOOTING (not just 'DM us') AND customer did not follow up with complaint
Thread has 2+ turns and brand provided solution (not just deflection)
exclusions: Brand response is ONLY 'DM us' / 'send us a DM' / 'let us know in DM' without any troubleshooting = NOT resolved
Customer expresses continued frustration after brand response = NOT resolved
